text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Light as a feather, but forceful as a rocket, Aston Machan has seized her dream! I knew she had this strength in her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Huff... Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Utterly exhausted, Aston Machan falls
to the turf
as the roar of the crowd
grows loud enough to
register on the
Richter scale.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man alive, that was amazing! We saw
history
being made today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Machan! You were awesome!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Aston Machan. It's Aston Machan. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...!
I couldn't do it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Damn it all!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text: But next time...

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Hah!
...Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho comes to a close, leaving
almost no
heart untouched.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm waiting for Aston Machan to finish
packing
up her things, I get a
notification on my phone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a message from the blog saying that
our views
have suddenly skyrocketed
today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I can now say I have the power of the
Oka Sho on
my side.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wonderful. It appears I've left my mark.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm going to go say hi to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess she's going to talk to the others
who ran
today? She heads out without
waiting for a
response, so I decide to
wait for her to return in
her own time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (I can still hear it if I close my eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(I can hear that beautiful sound, and see
that
beautiful scenery. It must all be
seared into
everyone's memories.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Splendid. Absolutely splendid.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now, everyone... I ask that you hold this
memory
tight.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hold it tight and treasure it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Machan, signing off.
